business_summary: Gladstone Capital Corporation is a business development company specializing in private equity and venture capital investments with a focus on lower middle market, growth capital, add on acquisitions, change of control, buy & build strategies, debt refinancing, debt investments in senior term loans, revolving loans, secured first and second lien term loans, senior subordinated loans, unitranche loans, junior subordinated loans, and mezzanine loans and equity investments in the form of common stock, preferred stock, limited liability company interests, or warrants. The fund also makes private equity investments in acquisitions, buyouts and recapitalizations, and refinancing existing debts. It targets small and medium-sized companies in United States. It is industry agnostic and seeks to invest in companies engaged in the business services, movies and entertainment, broadcasting and publishing, automobiles and components, food, beverage and tobacco, light and specialty manufacturing, niche industrial products and services, commercial services and supplies, specialty consumer products and services, construction machinery and heavy transportation equipment, energy services, agricultural and farm machinery, transportation and logistics, healthcare and education services, specialty chemicals, media and communications and aerospace and defense. The fund seeks to invest in debt between $8 million and $40 million in companies that have between $20 million and $150 million in sales and EBITDA between $3 million and $25 million. It prefers to acquire minority stakes. It seeks to exit its investments through strategic acquisitions by other industry participants or financial buyers, initial public offerings of common stock, or other capital market transactions.
business_summary_ko: Gladstone Capital Corporation은 중하위 시장, 성장 자본, 추가 인수, 지배권 변경, 구매 및 구축 전략, 부채 재융자, 선순위 대출에 대한 부채 투자, 회전 대출, 담보된 1차 및 2차 담보 대출, 선순위 후순위 대출, 단위 랜치 대출, 후순위 후순위 대출, 메자닌 대출 및 보통주, 우선주, 유한 책임 회사 지분 또는 워런트 형태의 주식 투자에 초점을 맞춘 사모 펀드 및 벤처 캐피탈 투자를 전문으로 하는 비즈니스 개발 회사입니다. 또한 이 펀드는 인수, 매수, 자본 확충, 기존 부채 재융자 등에 대한 사모펀드 투자도 수행합니다. 미국의 중소기업을 대상으로 합니다. 업계에 구애받지 않으며 비즈니스 서비스, 영화 및 엔터테인먼트, 방송 및 출판, 자동차 및 부품, 식품, 음료 및 담배, 조명 및 특수 제조, 틈새 산업 제품 및 서비스, 상업 서비스 및 공급품, 특수 소비재 및 서비스, 건설 기계 및 대형 운송 장비, 에너지 서비스, 농업 분야에 종사하는 회사에 투자하려고 합니다.
